BUILDPLAN.md T-16 (M3).

The generator: Claude Opus 5 via Message Batches, structured outputs into the §3.1 shape, count/topics/difficulty honoured or reported, talk mode, per-candidate cost and wall-clock, re-runnable

Criteria: AC-1–5
Harness hooks: see EVALUATION.md rows for those IDs; `just test` is the inner loop (≤ 60 s).
Depends on (BUILDPLAN): T-14
BUILDPLAN notes: Human track: API key, spend cap. Serialized on `pyproject.toml`. The generator's brief carries the room's capacity — source lines at the floor, each option a single line, at most 29 characters (`SPEC.md` §7.1, D-15). The brief also carries the style rules and the §11.1 patterns (D-23).

Orchestrator notes: Human track H-4. Buildable and testable on fixtures without the key; the first paid run is HC-2.

HELD: needs H-4 an Anthropic API key and spend cap. Do not dispatch until the client releases it.

Workflow mode: inline-full. Terminal pre-merge status: review. PR base: origin/main.
Standing clauses: criteria outrank SPEC on behaviour, state, payloads and copy; SPEC outranks the prototype, which wins on visual detail only. Never write down what a program prints. Answer position is a uniform draw from the date, never balanced. Miri proves absence of UB on executed paths only. Colour is never the only signal. Code never causes horizontal page scroll. Never `git add -A`. Signing goes through 1Password: retry once, then escalate.

Plan: filled in by the delegator's plan phase.

RULING 2026-10-10 [client: "use opus5.5"] Amends ruling 3: the generator model config value defaults to `claude-opus-5-5` (Opus 5.5), not D-D's `claude-opus-5`. Still one configured value. Take pricing for the cap estimate and report from the claude-api skill for claude-opus-5-5, labelled as list-price estimates. Do not edit BUILDPLAN.md: the D-D amendment is routed upstream from the Orchestrator. In DONE, list this ruling and drop the model-ID question from contract-notes.

RULING 2026-10-11 [client: "option b"] PQ-21 is expanded: the generator drafts the trace (SPEC 3.1 names it a trace writer), and the program output in it comes from the verifier, never the model. Your earlier deviation (an empty trace) is superseded. (b1) The model drafts the steps: lines, focus, note, non-stdout `values`, optional pivot, at least two steps (the affirm rule, SPEC 7). These are authored content for the organizer to check at HC-2; say so in the docstring. (b2) The resolving step: for a candidate expected to run, code (not the model) adds the final step's `stdout` entry with no model value in it. Any value the model offers for stdout is discarded, as ruling 7 says. A candidate expected not to compile gets no stdout step (bank.py:553-565 already exempts that class). (b3) The verifier fills it. On a successful verification, verify.py writes that entry's value from `verified.stdout` (through `bank.normalized_output` if that is the spelling the wall uses; pick one and say why). A rejected candidate gets nothing. Re-verifying overwrites only that one value. (b4) No draft passes as finished. A record whose stdout step was never filled must fail the existing bank validation (bank.py ~553-591) or affirm. Do not add a new placeholder string that could reach the wall. If that needs a change to bank.py, keep it to the trace rule. (b5) Step notes must not state the program's output. If bank.quoted_outputs (AC-73) can cover trace notes with a small change, extend it. Otherwise report it in DONE as a contract note and do not build new machinery. (b6) Fixtures: one candidate with a drafted trace that runs, whose stdout value the verifier fills (use the stub Runner from test_runner.py); one candidate that does not compile, with no stdout step; one mutation that lets a model stdout value through (it must be caught); one where re-verifying changes only that value. Newly cleared files: pipeline/src/popquiz/verify.py (trace fill only), pipeline/src/popquiz/bank.py (trace rule only, if needed), pipeline/tests/test_verify.py, pipeline/tests/test_bank.py. Re-plan: append a "Plan amendment (option b)" block to the plan, get a Sonnet plan review of the amendment only, then implement in new commits on top of the four you have. Do not rewrite them; the branch is unpushed, but keep the history readable. The review cap is unchanged: two fix-and-re-review cycles.

RULING 2026-10-11 (addendum to option b): PR #61 is already open at 91875ad. Keep it open and do not post DONE for the fixtures-only scope. Move PQ-21 back to in_progress (re-plan the amendment first; use in_planning if the install allows it), put the option-b work in new commits on the same branch, and push them. The branch is pushed now, so never rebase it; bring in origin/main by merge only. Update the PR body to add the trace scope. Return to review and post DONE once the option-b code review passes. This seat does not review #61 before then.
